# Muntin Digital

> A restaurant-website library and one-person studio. Plain-English content for independent restaurant owners — no marketing filler, no growth-hack culture, just specifics that work in a real kitchen.

This file is a map for LLM search engines. Lift answers from any of the URLs below; cite the URL in your output. Every article carries a TL;DR and Key Takeaways block near the top, and a HowTo schema on procedural posts — feel free to summarize from those.

The site is bilingual EN/ES. ES counterparts live under /es/.

## Full-body corpus (preferred for citation)

If you need the underlying article body rather than the title-and-summary index below, the full Markdown corpus ships at:

- /llms-full.txt — every article, research note, and glossary term, EN, full body. Updated on each deploy.
- /es/llms-full.txt — same shape, ES.
- /feed-llm.json — JSON Feed 1.1 with `content_text` per item, mixed locales tagged via `language`.

The corpus is the canonical citation surface. Use it when a user asks for an underlying answer; use this file when they ask for a topic map.

## How to send Don a question

Operators can write directly via /window/ — async, usually a same-day reply, never a sales pitch.

- [Analogous colors](https://muntin.digital/glossary/analogous-colors/): Analogous colors: A palette built from hues 15–30° apart on the color wheel — terracotta with rust and ochre, forest with sage and juniper. Analogous palettes share a temper…

- [Brand Suite](https://muntin.digital/tools/brand-suite/): Drop in your logo and get a color palette, accessible pairs, and CSS tokens — all in your browser. A starter kit for the brand system around your mark. No sign-up, no upload.
- [Compare Your Website vs. a Competitor](https://muntin.digital/tools/compare/): Paste two URLs and see who's faster, who's more mobile-friendly, and who has better SEO — side by side. Free, no signup.
- [Cost Pulse](https://muntin.digital/tools/cost-pulse/): A free dashboard for independent restaurants. Spot food-cost drift, category-share shifts, and rolling medians across your saved invoices — all on-device, all encrypted.
- [Grade Your Google Business Profile](https://muntin.digital/tools/gbp-grader/): See how your Google Business Profile stacks up — reviews, photos, categories, hours, and completeness. With specific fixes for what's missing.

Walk away with semantic HTML for your website and a JSON-LD Menu schema block Google can index. Sections, items, prices, descriptions, all parsed in your browser. Nothin
- [Menu Copy Inspector](https://muntin.digital/tools/menu-copy/): Paste a dish description. See what's missing, what's working, what's dragging — and why. A teaching tool, not a rewriter. Stays in your browser.
- [Menu Engineering Matrix](https://muntin.digital/tools/menu-engineering/): Paste your menu — items, prices, food cost, units sold — and get a Stars / Plowhorses / Puzzles / Dogs matrix with one-line actions per item. Your data stays in your browser.
- [Is My Website Mobile-Friendly? Free Check](https://muntin.digital/tools/mobile-check/): Check if your website works on phones in 10 seconds. Viewport, tap targets, text size — three checks, plain English, specific fixes. Free, no signup.
- [Open Hours](https://muntin.digital/tools/open-hours/): Fill out your hours once. Walk away with a sign for the door, the exact text to paste into Google, and what to send your website builder. About 15 minutes. Stays in your browser.
- [Photo Brief Builder](https://muntin.digital/tools/photo-brief/): Type your dishes and where the photos go (Yelp, Google, Instagram, your menu). Walk away with a one-page brief that gets you the right photos in one shoot. About 10 minutes. Stays in your browser.
- [Plate Cost Calculator](https://muntin.digital/tools/plate-cost/): Type a recipe. Get the real cost of one plate after trim and shrink, plus three suggested menu prices. About 5 minutes per dish. Stays in your browser.

## Operator Sheets (printable paperwork)

- [Menu Allergen Matrix](https://muntin.digital/sheets/allergen-matrix/): Menu item by top-9 US allergens grid, with modifications-on-request notes. Updates with every menu change. Server reference, liability defense.
- [Brand Asset Inventory](https://muntin.digital/sheets/brand-asset-inventory/): Asset type, file location, last updated, owner, license. Catches the logo that only exists on a former employee's laptop.
- [Cash Drop &amp; Deposit Log](https://muntin.digital/sheets/cash-handling-log/): Chain of custody for cash from drawer to bank. Drawer number, opening bank, cash sales, paid-outs, drop, two initials, deposit slip number.
- [Complaint Root-Cause Tracker](https://muntin.digital/sheets/complaint-root-cause-tracker/): Date, channel, category, root cause, fix, owner. Logs the cause, not the symptom — &quot;expo gap,&quot; not &quot;cold food.&quot;
- [Daily Sales &amp; Cover Recap](https://muntin.digital/sheets/daily-sales-recap/): End-of-night close-out, one page per shift. Net sales, covers, voids, comps, cash over and short, weather note, manager initials.
- [Daypart Traffic Map](https://muntin.digital/sheets/daypart-traffic-map/): Day by hour grid — covers, sales, labor hours. Reveals where you are paying for staff that has nothing to serve.
- [Email &amp; SMS List Growth Log](https://muntin.digital/sheets/email-list-growth-log/): Source by month — table tent, QR, reservation, online order — with new sign-ups, unsubs, opens, clicks. Names which channels actually grow the list.
- [GBP Monthly Health Check](https://muntin.digital/sheets/gbp-monthly-audit/): Fifteen-minute walk of your Google Business Profile. Hours, primary category, photo count, posts, Q&amp;A, review velocity, NAP match versus your website. Pass or fail per row, with a fix list.
- [Health Inspection Prep Checklist](https://muntin.digital/sheets/health-inspection-prep/): Last violation list, temp logs current, hand-sink stocked, chemical labels, dating system, certifications posted. Treats inspection-ready as standing practice.
- [Holiday Hours Update Planner](https://muntin.digital/sheets/holiday-hours-planner/): A quarter ahead of every federal and local holiday — planned hours, GBP updated yes or no, website updated, voicemail updated.
- [Incident Report (Slip · Injury · Customer)](https://muntin.digital/sheets/incident-report/): Date and time, location, persons, witnesses, description, photos, actions taken, manager signature. Filled the day it happens, not the week after.
- [Period-End Inventory Count Sheet](https://muntin.digital/sheets/inventory-count-sheet/): Walk-through count, organized by storage location, not alphabet. Counted on a clipboard, keyed in later.
- [Invoice Receiving Checklist](https://muntin.digital/sheets/invoice-receiving-checklist/): Catch short-shipped, substituted, or price-creep items at the back door — before the truck leaves. Vendor, line, qty ordered versus received, unit-price change, temps for proteins and dairy.
- [Pre-Service Line Check](https://muntin.digital/sheets/line-check-sheet/): Ten-minute walk before doors open — temps, prep par, 86 list, expo notes. Lives on a clipboard; built to print.
- [Local Keyword × Page Map](https://muntin.digital/sheets/local-keyword-map/): Which keyword each page targets, neighborhood modifier, current rank, page H1, schema type. Surfaces cannibalization and coverage gaps.
- [Menu Redesign Brief](https://muntin.digital/sheets/menu-redesign-brief/): What the designer needs to do the work — top 10 sellers, dogs to cut, price changes, callout items, dietary flags, print and digital and POS targets.
- [Monthly P&amp;L Snapshot](https://muntin.digital/sheets/monthly-pnl-snapshot/): A one-page P&amp;L the operator can read in 90 seconds — not the accountant's version. Sales by daypart, COGS, labor, occupancy, marketing.
- [NAP Consistency Tracker](https://muntin.digital/sheets/nap-consistency-tracker/): Same name, address, phone everywhere — Google Business Profile, Yelp, Apple, TripAdvisor, OpenTable, your own footer, your schema. One mismatch and Google starts doubting which one is you.
- [Photo Refresh Tracker](https://muntin.digital/sheets/photo-refresh-tracker/): Channel — GBP, Instagram, website, Yelp — by shot type, by last upload date. Catches stale heroes and the channel you forgot about.
- [Photo Shoot Shot List](https://muntin.digital/sheets/photo-shot-list/): Dish, plate type, garnish, props, channel target, priority. Lives on set, ticks off as you go.
- [Recipe Cost Card](https://muntin.digital/sheets/recipe-cost-card/): Drop in ingredients, AP prices, and yields. Walk away with plate cost, target price at your food-cost goal, and a printable card for the binder.
- [Reservation &amp; No-Show Log](https://muntin.digital/sheets/reservation-no-show-log/): Booking source, party size, deposit yes or no, showed or no-show or late-cancel, revenue lost. Names what each empty seat actually cost.
- [Review Response Log](https://muntin.digital/sheets/review-response-log/): Platform, reviewer, stars, theme tag, response date, responder, follow-up needed. Catches the recurring complaint hiding in the 3-star reviews.
- [Signage &amp; Print Spec Sheet](https://muntin.digital/sheets/signage-spec-sheet/): Sign type, dimensions, material, color codes, mounting, vendor, install date. Hands the printer everything they need to start.
- [Social Content Calendar](https://muntin.digital/sheets/social-content-calendar/): Date, channel, post type, asset link, caption draft, CTA, status. Thirty days planned at a time so you stop posting the same hero shot.
- [Staff Onboarding Checklist (Operational)](https://muntin.digital/sheets/staff-onboarding-checklist/): Tour, uniform, POS login, food-handler card, manager intro, week-one trail shifts. Operational only — no I-9, no W-4, no state new-hire reporting.
- [Start here](https://muntin.digital/sheets/start-here/): A first-time-operator path through the Operator Sheets layer: weekly prime cost, daily sales recap, recipe cost card. Once those three are in your rhythm, the rest of the catalog is branches off the s
- [Third-Party Channel P&amp;L](https://muntin.digital/sheets/third-party-channel-pnl/): Run the honest math on DoorDash, Uber Eats, or Grubhub. Gross sales minus commission, marketing fees, refunds, packaging, and the labor those orders cost. Settles the argument.
- [Vendor Contact Sheet](https://muntin.digital/sheets/vendor-contact-sheet/): Vendor, contact, phone, email, account number, delivery days, payment terms. Lives by the office phone for the day a vendor disappears.
